item.text:
Fixed CSV escaping so `Acme, Inc` stays in one field and records retain four columns. Commas, quotes, and line breaks are handled across all fields.

Contact names now retain their commas instead of replacing them with semicolons. Spreadsheet formula protection remains intact.

All five tests pass, including new regression coverage.
